title: Upper / lower
author: avneesh R.
desc:
Train four days across one week, alternating upper- and lower-body sessions.
Build strength and muscle with a full-gym mix of compound lifts and focused accessory work.
Upper-body training features Smith machine incline presses, dumbbell rows, pulldowns, and triceps work.
Plan for about 70 minutes per workout, with an intermediate level of challenge.
Finish the week with a balanced foundation for stronger, more muscular training.
